Old: VOP checkbox (old booking_form_widget.dart:523-525), CTA enabled only with consentsOk (:718-728); old entry moto_detail_page.dart:662 (70a94933) always set a fresh BookingDraft (consentVop default false, booking_models.dart:84). v2: same setter setVop (core/booking_form_widget.dart:532) -> booking_consents_v2.dart:42, same canProceedNow (:536-555) passed at :588 -> dock MgCta enabled/onTap only if canProceed (booking_dock_v2.dart:141-142) + dock line 'Potvrď souhlasy' (booking_form_view_v2.dart:174) + card title 'Souhlasy' + hint (booking_consents_v2.dart:39-61). BUT every v2 entry (detail, Home funnel, calculator) goes through startBookingFromSelection (booking_entry.dart:69-90) -> carryBookingDraft same-bike branch (booking_carry_v2.dart:35-44) returns prev.copyWith(...) which keeps consentVop from the earlier unpaid draft; v2 Home tab no longer clears the draft (shell_tab_action.dart:61). So on a second visit to the same bike (even with new dates) the box is already ticked and the CTA may be enabled without the customer ticking it for this booking. Server: no check (payment_screen.dart:834 only writes true values to profile). Owner decision 2026-10-22 noted in code, but weaker than the old look.
verdicts.fix_idea: In booking_carry_v2.dart same-bike branch (:36-43) add consentVop: false, consentGdpr: false, consentKids: false to prev.copyWith (v2-only code, old look untouched); if the owner keeps the carry, at least show a visible line 'Souhlasy převzaty z rozpracované rezervace' in BookingConsentsV2.
